purpose: New primary technical sources for the restarted autonomous PubMed integration; clinical/model sources reused from prior journal entries

sources.title: The E-utilities In-Depth: Parameters, Syntax and More
sources.authors_or_organization: Eric Sayers; National Center for Biotechnology Information
sources.read_level: Official 24-page PDF parsed; relevant ESearch pages 3-5 and EFetch pages 9-12 inspected. Canonical HTML returned browser challenge.
sources.supports: PubMed query/sort/retmax and batch EFetch XML parameter handling; not evidence of model/tool success or clinical reliability

sources.title: A General Introduction to the E-utilities
sources.authors_or_organization: Eric Sayers; National Center for Biotechnology Information
sources.read_level: Indexed official text for request frequency, tool/email and disclaimer guidance; direct canonical HTML/PDF returned browser challenges

clinical_reference_policy: Original frozen released labels and primary-trial facts remain evaluator-only. Newly returned articles and their complete metadata/read extents are recorded per run; no fabricated article or hidden gold packet.
product_claim_policy: Reuse source-backed OpenEvidence/Vera feature mapping as vendor-described inspiration; no claim of copying hidden vendor architecture.
